alibabacloud-pai-eas-service-deploy 0.0.1-beta.1

- Initial beta release for deploying AI models as Alibaba Cloud PAI-EAS inference services.
- Supports LLMs (Qwen, Llama), image generation models (SD, SDXL), speech synthesis, and more.
- Enforces pre-checks, mandatory API call sequence, and strict deployment rules (no duplicate service names).
- Requires aliyun CLI, aiworkspace and eas plugins, and jq for command execution and validation.
- Detailed operational steps and failure handling provided for reliable, autonomous service deployment.
